symptom: bare sensor breakout (no onboard pull-ups) on jumper wires: the scan finds nothing even though power LEDs are lit and the overlay is enabled.

dmesg_tail: i2c-1 i2c-1: transfer error: -121 (EREMOTEIO) on address probe

gold.diagnosis: Empty scan with the bus enabled and the device powered means SDA/SCL cannot settle — the bare module has no pull-up resistors. This is a wiring/hardware fault: STOP coding, add 4.7k pull-ups to 3.3 V (or use a breakout with them onboard).
